system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The Vesper clans unique physical physique places them into a category all their own with their physical strength. They dominate other shinobi with feats of physical strength and agility that seems, simply inhuman. You gain two of these options and another of your choice at 7th and 15th levels.

Anchored Steps

Creatures or effects that would attempt to move you against your will make their checks to do so at disadvantage. You also make saving throws or checks to resist being moved at advantage.

Dominating Stability

Creatures struggle to challenge you physically. You gain a rank of mastery to Strength Saving throws.

Dinner Bell

Combat for you feels like a chance to feed on the failure of your foes. When initiative is rolled, you can spend your Reaction. If you do, you gain a rank of Mastery to all d20 based rolls you make before the end of your next turn.

Gravestone Dragging

You are physically superior to most other shinobi of a similar stature to you. Increase your Bulk by +5. Additionally, when attempting to move while grappling a creature, moving does not count as difficult terrain for you.

Inhuman Stamina

Your physical stamina cannot be compared. Checks and saving throws made to resist gaining ranks of Exhaustion are made at advantage. Additionally, if you spend an Action to Dash, you can spend your Bonus Action during the same turn to Dash again.

Launching Throw

Objects, items or tools that allow you to throw them, have an increased range of +20 feet. Additionally, you gain a rank of Mastery to Shove attempts. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th and three ranks at 15th level.

Vaulted Limbs

When chakra movement techniques aren’t available, the old fashion way is more than doable for you. You gain a Climbing speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, reduce the number of fall damage dice rolled by an amount equal to half your level.
